Create RebelTrackDataFrame Object

Source: R/rebeltrack_dataframe.R
rebeltrack_dataframe.Rd

Create a RebelTrackDataFrame grouped by side and period.

rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset, side, period, balanced = FALSE)

Arguments

dataset

A RebelTrackDataSet object

side

One of SIDE_A/SIDE_B, "A"/"B", "a"/"b", or 1/2

period

Any date interval supported by seq.Date such as "day(s)", "week(s)", "month(s)", "quarter(s)", or "year(s)", optionally preceded by an integer, for example "3 months".

balanced

Either TRUE or FALSE. If TRUE, a balanced panel is returned.

Examples

library(rebeltrack)

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dataset <- rebeltrack_load_dataset(type = UCDP_NON_STATE)

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_A,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE)
} # }
